data.name: Dorthy
data.long_meaning: The name Dorthy is derived from the Old English word thorith, meaning 'door' or 'gift.' The name was later adopted from the Old Greek Dorothea, which translates to 'gift of God.' Dorthy is a name rich in symbolism, representing the idea of God's blessings and protection.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's gift and blessings.

The name carries a cheerful and wholesome connotation, reminiscent of the simple yet strong-willed character Dorothy from Oz.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Dorthy signifies the idea of being a gift from God, emphasizing the inherit value and worth of every individual. Additionally, the name carries the symbolism of a door, reminding us that God opens new opportunities and possibilities in our lives, and is always present to guide us on our journey.
